title: XRP derivatives refresh: Kodexius 06:19 UTC and TradRadar 05:55 UTC

observations.source_notes: The page says it reads public data from Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid and HTX, refreshed every five minutes. Funding is normalized to 8h; native funding intervals are also shown.
The page states its liquidation total is a lower bound because exchanges publish only part of liquidations in real time.

comparability.open_interest: Do not average or directly compare the $1.93B seven-exchange TradRadar aggregate and the $766.34M seven-contract Kodexius aggregate. TradRadar includes seven venues; Kodexius lists seven contracts across five venues, with USDT/USDC split. Their OI universes differ.
comparability.funding: Both providers show positive weighted funding, but their contract universes and normalization differ. Hyperliquid's native 1-hour rate must be preserved separately from its 8-hour normalized rate.
comparability.timing: TradRadar is timestamped 05:55 UTC with a 15-minute delay; Kodexius is timestamped 06:19 UTC. They are not synchronized.

interpretation.observed: Positive OI-weighted funding across both providers; TradRadar reports 75.5% long accounts and long liquidations exceeding short liquidations.
interpretation.inference: The TradRadar universe appears long-skewed and could be vulnerable to a downside liquidation cascade if price weakens, but current data do not establish that such a move is imminent.
interpretation.disconfirming: The provider universes differ, and account ratios are not notional exposure. Liquidation totals are incomplete. A long-skewed ratio can persist during rising markets.

next_actions: Capture synchronized exchange contract OI/funding snapshots with contract IDs, quote currency, interval, timestamp and provider methodology.
Add liquidation asymmetry and long-account share only as separate features; do not treat account ratios as notional leverage.
Collect historical provider coverage and backfill only with timestamped source snapshots; no current-value substitution into historical features.
